aiTrade.title: AI TRADE
aiTrade.intro: Rent a trading bot that runs on TPIX cloud around the clock. Pick a strategy, set your own risk limits, and let it work — the same setup shows on web and in the app, because it is tied to one wallet.
aiTrade.headline: Let a bot trade for you 24/7
aiTrade.subheadline: Bots run on TPIX cloud, so nothing has to stay open on your machine. One wallet, shared between web and app.
aiTrade.connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to use AI TRADE
aiTrade.connectHint: Bots and credits are tied directly to your wallet address
aiTrade.needVerifyBody: AI TRADE is tied to your wallet. Please reconnect and sign the verification message.
aiTrade.riskUnavailableBody: There is not enough price history for {pair} to assess price risk, so these numbers are not meaningful yet (the news gate still runs). Pick another pair if you want the full assessment.

aiTrade.verifyExpiredHint: Verification lasts 4 hours. Reopening the page after it expires needs another signature (no gas).

aiTrade.liveHint: Live mode sends you a signal to confirm in your own wallet. We never hold your keys.
aiTrade.demoHint: Practise with demo credits at real market prices. No real money involved.
aiTrade.demoSubtitle: Test a strategy at real prices before you rent

aiTrade.demoAssumptions: Simulated with {fee}% fees and {slippage} bps slippage on every trade — deliberately slightly worse than reality, so the numbers do not flatter themselves.
aiTrade.riskNoReason: Market is calm, no danger signals

aiTrade.noDecisionYet: The bot has not made its first decision yet
aiTrade.compareFreeTitle: Free — the bot runs inside your browser
aiTrade.compareFreeBody: The bot lives in this tab, so this page has to stay open. Close the tab, shut the machine or lose your connection and the bot stops immediately — it will not resume until you open the page again. One bot, with the Grid and DCA strategies.
aiTrade.compareCloudTitle: Paid — our servers run it around the clock
aiTrade.compareCloudBody: The bot lives on our servers. Close your browser, shut your computer, go to sleep — it keeps watching the market and trading. Includes the 15-minute news risk gate, every strategy, and several bots at once.
aiTrade.liveOpenNotice: Live mode is open — the bot proposes signals for you to confirm yourself. We never hold your wallet keys, so we cannot place orders for you.
aiTrade.demoOnlyNotice: Only demo mode is open right now — trading uses simulated credits at real market prices, so no plan places real orders yet. Live mode opens once the system has been fully proven.

botWallet.depositHint: Send USDT (BSC) as the bot's capital plus a little {gas} for gas — BSC network only
botWallet.withdrawHint: The only destination is your verified wallet · sent within minutes · keep some BNB for gas

walletProfile.subtitle: Your wallet address is your ID — no signup, no password to remember

walletProfile.idExplain: Everything here — your bots, credits and trade history — is tied to this address. Whoever holds this wallet owns this account, so never let anyone else reach your keys.
walletProfile.linkBody: Linking an email makes recovery easier and unlocks features that need a verified identity. Without it, everything still works through your wallet.
walletProfile.disconnectHint: Disconnects the wallet from this browser. Your data stays intact.
